findings.title: Executive host controls bypass the direct Python administrator boundary

evidence.reason: Router has no verified-administrator dependency.
Checkpoint handler resets/stages shared work and can commit it.
Rollback handler invokes destructive Git reset/clean.
Explicit router mount; dynamic plugin discovery is additional.
Guard protects the unversioned executive alias, not this versioned family.

findings.impact: Unverified callers reaching the direct API can request destructive source changes, approve actions, change autonomy and alter cloud settings.
findings.ingress: Direct Python gap. Go proxy has an /exec substring counter-boundary at go-core/pkg/telemetry/security.go:166; remote loaded reachability not exercised.
findings.proposed_remediation: Require verified administration inside the router and private/no-store; hold legacy shared-tree Git mutation until a scoped recovery-aware contract exists.
findings.safe_offline_fixture: AST-extract handlers with synthetic identities and forbidden subprocess/dispatcher fakes; assert anonymous/spoofed denial and authenticated destructive503 before effects.

findings.title: Raw document-upload alias permits unconstrained host writes

evidence.reason: Upload alias has no verified-owner dependency.
Client filename is assigned as safe without normalization or root containment.
Joined path is opened for overwrite.
Document path guard covers /api/documents, not /documents.

findings.impact: Traversal or rooted upload names can escape the intended vault and overwrite host files under process permissions; body/file-size bounds are absent.
findings.ingress: Direct Python source gap; Go gateway does not proxy bare /documents by its normal /api and /v1 catchalls.
findings.proposed_remediation: Protect every alias with verified document authority; enforce size, selected roots, path/alias rules, safe handles and conflict-preserving publication.
findings.safe_offline_fixture: Extract handler into temporary vault; synthetic traversal/rooted/ADS/reserved/case-collision filenames must be rejected before any writer; prove existing canary bytes unchanged.

findings.title: Versioned media namespace exposes arbitrary host reads and script writes

evidence.reason: Versioned media router lacks authentication.
Stream serves any existing supplied path via FileResponse.
Manim endpoint forwards user code and output name.
Output name enters a script path without root containment before writing.
Media router explicitly mounted; global guard uses /api/media rather than /api/v1/media.

findings.impact: Potential credential/private-file disclosure and arbitrary Python-file overwrite. Script generation is not proof of immediate execution; rendering routines also have unsupported completion claims.
findings.ingress: Direct Python source gap; individual Go paths containing /execute receive a counter-boundary, while /stream and /render/manim/scene do not.
findings.proposed_remediation: Add router-level verified authority and bounded owner/root-scoped artifacts; hold raw code paths or route them through approved isolated execution; return truthful prepared/unavailable states.
findings.safe_offline_fixture: Temporary-file read/write canaries, forbidden process fixtures and untrusted output names; no production file or renderer execution.

findings.title: USB rebuild bypasses destructive-mode policy and interpolates command input

evidence.reason: Router uses caller client label, not verified authority.
Filesystem and volume label are unconstrained strings.
Caller confirmation is the only initial action gate.
PowerShell clears/rebuilds disk and interpolates request strings; no global destructive flag check.

findings.impact: Unverified callers can request real USB erasure; command text permits injection. USB/non-system preflight does not replace caller authorization or eliminate identity races.
findings.ingress: Neither current Python control prefixes nor Go sensitive fragments cover /api/usb-recovery.
findings.proposed_remediation: Require verified host administration; hold rebuild until device identity, exact command schema and recovery are verified; use strict enums/labels and no string interpolation.
findings.safe_offline_fixture: Extracted schema/router with forbidden subprocess/ctypes fakes; unauthenticated/spoofed requests deny; even admin confirmation must not reach destructive preflight/format during containment.

findings.title: Repair-ticket privacy and object ownership can be bypassed

evidence.reason: Tenant comes from caller header.
Ticket listing accepts that label.
Status update has no caller/owner dependency.
Update predicate uses ticket ID without owner.

findings.impact: Customer/contact/device records can be read via spoofed tenant labels and modified by guessed IDs; creation also propagates unverified records to memory.
findings.ingress: Mounted /api/repair family has no applicable Python global boundary.
findings.proposed_remediation: Verified administrator/owner admission, owner-scoped immutable identifiers and explicit legacy ownership migration; no adoption of header labels.
findings.safe_offline_fixture: Two synthetic owners and temporary tables; guessed-ID read/update must404 and preserve the other owner; no production rows.

findings.title: Legacy storefront credits/leads remain unowned and fabricate success

evidence.reason: Tenant is an arbitrary header/default.
Import initializes live schema.
Balance GET creates credits and reports fabricated credits on storage error.
Generation deducts credits before model success, outside a durable idempotent workflow.
Lead reads are scoped only by the caller label.

findings.impact: Cross-account CRM access, invented entitlements, duplicate/lost credit accounting and false generated success on transport failure.
findings.ingress: Explicitly mounted /api/storefront is not covered by existing financial router-level protection.
findings.proposed_remediation: Contain paid/credit admission; require verified ownership, exact durable idempotent accounting and explicit unavailable states; preserve legacy rows without adopting them.
findings.safe_offline_fixture: AST/fake transport and temporary DB; anonymous denial before IO, no balance initialization on GET, rollback on failures, durable same-key retry, owner-isolation checks.

findings.title: NDA signing/integrity claims lack verified signer authority and safe key configuration

evidence.reason: NDA router has no verified authority dependency.
Sensitive HMAC environment setting has a nonempty source fallback; value omitted.
Caller-asserted signer/IP/verification fields produce sealed documents and disk copies.

findings.impact: Anonymous asserted identities can create signed/protected artifacts; absent secret configuration has publicly knowable fallback material. Actual credential configuration and legal validity not assessed.
findings.ingress: Mounted /api/v1/nda not covered by current generic administrator/document guard families.
findings.proposed_remediation: Verified signer/admin provenance and fail-closed secret configuration; distinguish draft, consent, signature and tamper-evidence states; no legal-validity claims from hashes.
findings.safe_offline_fixture: Synthetic document bytes/signers, fake PDF renderer and temporary output only; missing secret/identity denies before generation/write.

findings.title: Independent Node proxy permits arbitrary URL fetching and shared provider use

evidence.reason: Wildcard CORS and no authentication middleware.
Fetch action can consume configured shared provider credentials.
Untrusted target text contributes to an output filename.
Group-ID utility fetches caller URL without destination/redirect constraints.
Independent loopback listener, outside FastAPI guards.

findings.impact: Server-side access to private network targets, unbounded fetches, shared-key resource use and output paths outside intended scope are possible.
findings.ingress: Separate Node port3001 source; actual process/ingress not exercised.
findings.proposed_remediation: Verified owner admission, allowed public destinations with DNS/redirect pinning, time/size budgets, explicit provider-spend policy and safe artifact IDs.
findings.safe_offline_fixture: Fake fetch/DNS/filesystem; loopback/private/redirect targets deny before transport, timeout/oversize fail, output containment and owner transitions.

findings.title: Genkit paid-model action has no independent caller/spend boundary

evidence.reason: Action invokes hosted model generation.
Wildcard CORS precedes an unauthenticated HTTP action.
Listener does not explicitly bind loopback.

findings.impact: Potential unauthenticated use of configured provider credentials and resource spending; no owner, budget or bounded recovery is visible in this service.
findings.ingress: Independent Express service; deployment/configuration/credential validity not checked.
findings.proposed_remediation: Default-held external generation, verified identity/budget policy, explicit loopback binding and bounded schema/time/output; no reliance on Python middleware.
findings.safe_offline_fixture: Fake ai.generate and request identity; absent identity/config/budget must deny without provider invocation; controlled timeout/error responses.

findings.title: Media pipeline certifies stages without executing them

evidence.reason: Pipeline saves initialization as completed.
Each supplied stage is marked COMPLETED without dispatching its domain operation.
API returns this result as successful execution.

findings.impact: Phantom completion/checkpoints and misleading resume/output claims; multiple neighboring transforms also return invented output metadata.
findings.ingress: Mounted media namespace; source behavior confirmed, no pipeline executed.
findings.proposed_remediation: Separate plans from executed artifacts; only immutable artifact receipts may complete a stage; failed/unimplemented stages remain held/unavailable.
findings.safe_offline_fixture: Fake stage registry/checkpoint store; missing operation, failed operation and absent/mismatched output cannot mark completion or report success.

findings.title: Self-healing router requests an export absent from its owning source

evidence.reason: Imports get_self_healing_sentinel.
Owning module defines an AST quality gate and sanitizer, but no requested factory export.

findings.impact: Ordinary fresh import cannot satisfy the router dependency; declarations and UI may advertise unavailable functionality. Do not restore unsafe autonomous editing merely to hide this gap.
findings.ingress: Explicit mount and plugin discovery catch import errors; loaded in-memory state not inspected.
findings.proposed_remediation: Resolve the intended ownership contract; keep unsupported healer operations explicitly unavailable until isolated repair/recovery is proven.
findings.safe_offline_fixture: Static export/import assertion or extracted minimal import fixture with no application/module side effects; absent implementation reports unavailable, never successful healing.

findings.title: Legacy crypto reads/manual ledgers bypass owner admission while trading stays held

evidence.reason: Private balance adapter lacks verified caller dependency.
Open-order/trade/deposit-address adapters call configured private exchange service.
Caller floats enter an unowned trade ledger without fill evidence.
Schema initialization executes at module import.

findings.impact: Private exchange/ledger data disclosure, caller-asserted financial history and import-time financial-store mutation; this does not establish that held order dispatch executes.
findings.ingress: Go /crypto fragment protects CRO proxy requests; direct Python /api/crypto lacks equivalent generic boundary. /api/trading is a separate namespace.
findings.proposed_remediation: Verified financial owner admission and held private provider reads pending explicit read authorization; label manual legacy rows unreconciled and prevent implicit initialization.
findings.safe_offline_fixture: Fake exchange and temporary records only; anonymous calls cannot import provider or read ledger, false fills cannot become verified metrics; retain all current order holds.

findings.title: Dynamic package can enter a protected financial namespace without its owner boundary

evidence.reason: Separate router shares /api/accounting without verified owner dependency.
Draft creates invoice identifiers/events from unowned float/caller labels.
Dynamic loader mounts eligible package router independently of canonical accounting router.

findings.impact: Canonical router protection does not protect neighboring routes under the same prefix; unverified financial events can be emitted.
findings.ingress: Source dynamic package mount candidate, not observed runtime registration.
findings.proposed_remediation: Inventory all namespace owners and apply consistent verified admission; keep draft events explicitly unverified and separate from receipts/entitlements.
findings.safe_offline_fixture: Compose extracted canonical/package routers in an offline FastAPI fixture; every financial route denies anonymous/spoofed identity before event/storage work.

findings.title: Dynamic plugin registration and lifespan replacement obscure active coverage

evidence.reason: Discovers and imports all valid modules/routers.
Replaces router lifespan with no-op before including it.
Optional initialization hook executes on discovery.
Loader runs during main module initialization in addition to explicit mounts.

findings.impact: Duplicate/changed lifecycles, import-side effects and silently skipped plugins are unresolved. Static declaration counts are not active endpoint counts.
findings.ingress: Source-only candidates; no import or route registration performed in discovery.
findings.proposed_remediation: Use explicit deterministic plugin manifests and reviewed lifecycle ownership; reconcile source graph with authenticated metadata-only loaded-route inventory after gate.
findings.safe_offline_fixture: Synthetic plugins/canary initializers, deterministic order, exact mount/prefix deduplication and lifecycle start/stop ownership; no discovery of real plugins in tests.

findings.title: Frontend subscription gate admits lower tiers to enterprise-permitted tools
findings.impact: No-user/unknown-plan handling defaults to enterprise tier, and allowed enterprise permission admits unrelated tiers. This does not prove a backend authorization bypass.
findings.repair: Use verified entitlement state and compare the actual caller tier. Keep server authorization independently authoritative.

findings.title: Money Track presents seeded balances, fills and active workloads as current records
findings.dataflow: hardcoded React state/current-time formatting -> portfolio/order/mining cards; failed reads retain defaults
findings.impact: Refresh can make fixture orders look recent, while failed telemetry leaves an active workload claim. All original numeric/customer literals are intentionally omitted.
findings.repair: Replace unsupported financial/operational values and order history with explicit unavailable states; admit only verified owned records, preserve zero as distinct from missing, use owner-bound requests.

findings.title: Media separation failure manufactures READY output sessions
findings.dataflow: separation POST or failed vault GET -> catch/non-2xx fallback -> synthetic output names/session or online vault state -> readiness badge
findings.impact: Unavailable/failed work is displayed as completed output. A successful HTTP response also falls back to invented artifacts when metadata is absent.
findings.repair: Remove seeded and failure-generated sessions; persist visible errors and unknown outcomes; mark ready only using a confirmed owning API completion/artifact contract. Missing vault records remain unavailable.

findings.title: Cluster workspace reports timer-only execution and benchmark completion
findings.dataflow: button -> local timers/log state -> workflow/benchmark/cleanup success claims without system acknowledgement
findings.repair: Hold unsupported actions or label explicit demonstrations; expose actual authenticated system receipts before completion claims.

findings.title: Native traffic dashboard fabricates successful packets and hash identifiers
findings.dataflow: view construction/QTimer -> seeded or random traffic/status/latency -> generated hash -> live-looking table
findings.repair: Replace with verified owned telemetry or unavailable states; isolate any deliberate fixture mode and never label synthetic hashes as captured packet evidence.

findings.title: Media editing controls claim completed transformations and quality checks without rendering
findings.dataflow: inpaint/matting/director control -> local timer -> completed output/quality claim
findings.repair: Use accepted/running/completed states from a versioned job/artifact contract, otherwise hold output verification.

findings.title: Expo action deck reports unexecuted probes/harvest and mislabels failed flush
findings.dataflow: mobile onPress -> local status/timer or rejected HTTP -> completed/sent status
findings.repair: Report unavailable or explicit simulation for unimplemented actions; reject non-2xx and require actual acknowledgement; no provider calls needed for regression tests.

findings.title: Broadcast service probing treats opaque or non-success HTTP as online
findings.dataflow: no-cors fetch resolves -> unconditional online service status
findings.repair: Use an authenticated/versioned readable health response or unknown state; clear all timeout handles and distinguish reachable HTTP from healthy service.

findings.title: Standalone storefront fabricates actor/production state and carries independent stale crypto copy
findings.dataflow: bundled identity/default profile -> email-scoped balance/control fetches; missing crypto values -> numeric zero formatting
findings.impact: Frontend actor/production labels do not establish authentication or live service readiness. Server authorization and deployed build identity were not exercised.
findings.repair: Use verified identity/no-store owned requests, explicit held trading states and unavailable missing values; track this independent app separately from the main four mirrors.

findings.title: Several nested hubs/client selector do not synchronize deep-link state
findings.dataflow: URL query -> initial useState only or ignored -> local selection without URL/back/forward synchronization
findings.repair: Define supported nested route keys, initialize/synchronize them and show unknown-state notices instead of unrelated fallback screens.

findings.title: Global token interceptor lacks account-generation validation after asynchronous token lookup
findings.dataflow: captured currentUser -> await token -> originalFetch without owner recheck/cancellation
findings.impact: A pending request may dispatch with the prior account after identity changes. Existing feature-specific financial boundaries are stronger; other consumers need reconciliation.
findings.repair: Use account-bound sessions/current-identity checks and suppress stale responses; prove with delayed-token and delayed-response synthetic fixtures.

findings.title: Trainer exposes a broad IPC command bridge and listener lifetime lacks scoped disposal
findings.dataflow: renderer control -> generic IPC payload -> host daemon; callback replaces all listeners rather than returning scoped unsubscribe
findings.repair: Audit sender/frame and command schema at the host boundary, preserve allowed local controls, and return scoped listener cleanup. Do not exercise memory/process actions during discovery.

findings.title: Static navigation counts and fallback routing disagree across surfaces
findings.dataflow: default catalog/aliases/dynamic module cards -> renderer fallback; native registry comments and dispatcher differ
findings.impact: Default web navigation has44 entries, actual web registration72, industry cards71, native subtabs53; counts alone are not acceptance. Native unknown keys fall back to cockpit.
findings.repair: Reconcile catalogs/aliases/current rendered identities and classify dormant/unknown routes explicitly.
